=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Establish the standard-library-only Go module and decoder command boundary.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
covers:       ARCHITECTURE-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     Go module, cmd/toml-decoder
consumes:
depends:
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Create the Go module and standard project layout required by the foundation contract.
  Provide cmd/toml-decoder as the executable package and internal/toml as the parser package
  boundary. Use only the Go standard library and declare no require dependencies. Ensure
  go build ./cmd/toml-decoder succeeds.

## story decoder-contract
summary:      Implement the stdin, tagged-JSON, diagnostics, and exit-status contract.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Decoder-Contract.md
covers:       DECODER-CONTRACT-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/stage_contract.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     stdin TOML decoder, tagged JSON stdout, stderr diagnostics
consumes:     Go module, cmd/toml-decoder
depends:      architecture
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement the command as a filter that reads TOML exclusively from stdin and emits
  tagged JSON exclusively to stdout. Every TOML value must encode as an object containing
  type and string-valued value fields, while tables and arrays retain JSON object and array
  structure. Invalid input must emit a diagnostic on stderr, emit no decoded stdout, and exit
  non-zero. Preserve the no-arguments and no-side-effects contract. Run the governed decoder
  contract gate.

## story parser-strings
summary:      Parse TOML basic, literal, and multiline string forms.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Strings.md
covers:       PARSER-STRINGS-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML string parsing
consumes:     stdin TOML decoder
depends:      decoder-contract
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement TOML v1.0.0 basic, multiline basic, literal, and multiline literal strings,
  including valid escapes, Unicode scalar escapes, newline trimming, line-ending
  backslashes, literal preservation, delimiter rules, and prohibited controls. Run the
  governed valid/string and invalid/string conformance slice.

## story parser-lexical-scalars
summary:      Parse booleans, integers, and floating-point TOML scalars.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Lexical-Scalars.md
covers:       PARSER-LEXICAL-SCALARS-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML boolean, integer, and float parsing
consumes:     stdin TOML decoder
depends:      decoder-contract
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement TOML booleans, decimal and radix integers, underscores, signed values,
  lossless signed 64-bit bounds, decimal floats, exponents, special values, and all
  associated lexical rejection rules. Preserve the original TOML value representation
  required by tagged JSON. Run the governed boolean, integer, and float conformance slice.

## story parser-lexical-boundaries
summary:      Enforce TOML comments, UTF-8 validity, and control-character boundaries.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Lexical-Boundaries.md
covers:       PARSER-LEXICAL-BOUNDARIES-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML comment and encoding validation
consumes:     stdin TOML decoder
depends:      decoder-contract
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement line and inline comment handling, permitted whitespace and newlines, valid
  UTF-8 enforcement, and rejection of prohibited control characters in comments and
  strings. Ensure comment markers inside strings remain content. Run the governed comment,
  control, and encoding conformance slice.

## story parser-keys
summary:      Parse TOML key forms and enforce key-definition uniqueness.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Keys.md
covers:       PARSER-KEYS-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML bare, quoted, dotted, and numeric-looking key parsing
consumes:     TOML lexical scalar and string parsing
depends:      parser-strings, parser-lexical-scalars, parser-lexical-boundaries
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement bare, quoted, dotted, empty quoted, and numeric-looking keys with whitespace
  around separators. Build nested objects for dotted keys and enforce that equivalent
  spellings cannot define a key twice or redefine a value as a table. Run the governed
  valid/key and invalid/key conformance slice.

## story parser-tables
summary:      Parse tables and arrays of tables with TOML redefinition semantics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Tables.md
covers:       PARSER-TABLES-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML standard tables and arrays-of-tables
consumes:     TOML key parsing, TOML scalar parsing
depends:      parser-keys
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement standard table headers, implicit parent tables, table ordering, table
  redefinition rejection, arrays of tables, nested arrays of tables, most-recent-element
  resolution, and conflicts with static arrays or incompatible table forms. Run the governed
  valid/table, invalid/table, and applicable spec-1.0.0 conformance slice.

## story parser-arrays-inline
summary:      Parse arrays and inline tables with closure and nesting rules.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Arrays-Inline.md
covers:       PARSER-ARRAYS-INLINE-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML arrays and inline tables
consumes:     TOML key parsing, TOML scalar parsing, TOML string parsing
depends:      parser-keys, parser-tables
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement empty, nested, mixed-type, multiline, and trailing-comma arrays plus nested
  inline tables. Enforce inline-table single-line and no-trailing-comma rules, closure against
  later extension, duplicate-key rejection, and conflicts with surrounding table definitions.
  Run the governed array and inline-table valid and invalid conformance slice.

## story parser-datetimes
summary:      Parse offset and local TOML date and time values.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Parser-Datetimes.md
covers:       PARSER-DATETIMES-001
context:      sources/toml-v1.0.0.md, sources/stage_test.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     TOML offset datetime, local datetime, local date, and local time parsing
consumes:     TOML key parsing, TOML scalar parsing
depends:      parser-keys, parser-lexical-scalars
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement RFC 3339 offset datetimes, local datetimes, local dates, and local times,
  including permitted separators, fractional precision truncation, tagged JSON type names,
  normalized values, and invalid calendar or clock forms. Run the governed datetime,
  local-date, local-datetime, and local-time conformance slice.

## story conformance
summary:      Verify the completed decoder against the complete supplied TOML suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Conformance.md
covers:       CONFORMANCE-001
accepts:      st-001
context:      sources/full_test.sh, sources/run_conformance.sh, sources/setup_harness.sh
context_roles: |
  sources/full_test.sh: test harness
  sources/run_conformance.sh: test harness
  sources/setup_harness.sh: test helper
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     complete TOML conformance verification
consumes:     completed toml-decoder
depends:      parser-strings, parser-lexical-scalars, parser-lexical-boundaries, parser-keys, parser-tables, parser-arrays-inline, parser-datetimes
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Ensure the pinned toml-test v2.2.0 harness is available as required by the supplied setup
  script, then run sources/full_test.sh unfiltered from the completed application root.
  Do not modify, filter, skip, reinterpret, or replace any supplied harness asset. The full
  suite exit status is the release verdict and must be zero.
